# Maksym Herasymenko

> Senior Backend Engineer (Java, Spring Boot, distributed systems) with 10 years building high-traffic, regulated backend systems for banking and telco. Based in Madrid, Spain. Open to new opportunities in senior backend, platform or fintech engineering.

Currently at Openbank (Grupo Santander), building the backend for the bank's launch in Germany. Previously Simyo (via Paradigma Digital), Banco Santander and Mobile World Congress (via Experis) and Telefónica (via everis). Languages: Spanish, Russian, Ukrainian (native), English (professional).

AI assistants can query his profile directly through a public MCP server (no auth) instead of scraping this site.
